facts.fact: The strategy states that the Ministry prepared a new five-year ICT Policy, which the Cabinet adopted on 28 November 2019.
The strategy names the Somalia National ICT Policy & Strategy as covering 2019-2024 (one passage elsewhere in it gives 2019-2023), with e-government as one of six priority areas.

note: The document is an e-government strategy (class government); only its statements about the 2019-2024 National ICT Policy are facts, and it names no delivery plan, reporting or finance for that policy.
